name: Test Runner
description: Run a workspace's Vitest or Jest tests from the sidebar, re-run them when an agent finishes, and send failures back to the agent to fix.

cover.alt: The Test Runner panel with a failing and a passing run, and a notification that tests fail after an agent finished

screenshots.alt: A failing test in the panel and the one-line prompt Test Runner types into the agent
screenshots.caption: Failures go back to the agent in one click

screenshots.alt: The panel while tests run, failing tests in the light theme, and all tests passing in the dark theme
screenshots.caption: Built with Orca components: light, dark, native

commands.title: Test Runner: Run tests in this workspace

settings.title: Run tests when an agent finishes
settings.description: Re-runs a workspace's tests when one of its agents finishes a turn that changed files.

settings.title: Notify after automatic runs
settings.description: Shows a desktop notification when an automatic run fails, or passes again after failing.

settings.title: Agent to start
settings.description: Started with the failure when the workspace has no agent to send it to.
